checks.detail: Expected 8 pages; generated 8.
Each required heading must appear on its intended page.
Cover identifies the product, decision, readiness, and next action.
Executive decision page includes the canonical decision facts and watch point.
A clean product GO must authorize launch preparation without being downgraded by concept evidence.
Low concept n limits named consumer and market claims without downgrading product GO.
Launch-blocking language is prohibited unless a separate critical product gate has failed.
Report follows decision, evidence, product direction, and validation/release flow.
Decision basis must explain evidence quality, sensitivity, limitations, and the management authorization.
Validation protocol identifies the method, passing criteria, ownership, timing, budget status, and next gate.
Product readiness covers manufacturing, packaging, regulatory, labeling, and nutrition evidence without the deferred shelf-life workstream.
Commercial readiness covers competition, price, economics, channel, buyer strategy, and demand evidence.
Blocked status is reserved for external claims; ordinary commercial evidence gaps use validation language.
Every major score has a nearby business implication.
Project instrumental evidence, product risks, and citation-backed scientific context must remain visibly separate.
The commercial proposition must disclose the concept sample size and evidence boundary.
Commercial case presents the proposition and visually summarizes consumer, competition, price, economics, channel, and demand readiness.
Final page closes with a claim-by-claim release matrix and report status.
Technical identifiers and calculation tables are excluded from the client PDF.
Forbidden generic interpretation phrases are absent.
Client-facing numbers must not contain raw floating-point artifacts.
Product identity must remain consistent with the selected product format.
Client-facing text must not contain internal evidence or system phrases.
Client-facing literature must not expose storage paths, raw filenames, or retrieval-pack identifiers.
Client-facing copy must not contain sentence fragments or known generated-language failures.
Product direction must translate evidence rather than dump raw metrics.
No repeated caveat sentence detected.
